sermon.title: Conference Report
sermon.speaker: A Vine Cluster Church member (guest speaker), with closing words by Pastor David G. Kincer
sermon.summary: In “Conference Report,” a Vine Cluster Church member, asked by Pastor David G. Kincer to be a witness, reports what he heard at a pastors’ conference: calls to preach righteousness without fear, stories of believers attacked for their convictions, and a plea for the church to unite and get involved. Pastor Kincer then closes, saying the church cannot justify silence and that America needs a message of hope, illustrated by David and Goliath and by Paul at Corinth.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear. Editor notes: Most of this recording (to about 37:30) is a church member’s report on a conference; Pastor Kincer speaks from about 37:30 to the end. Names of people mentioned are spelled as heard; where a name was not clear in the captions it is marked [unclear]. At 32:40 the reference is given as “Matthew [unclear] 12:48”; the passage read is Matthew 12:48-50. Some passages are quoted without a reference (e.g. Proverbs 29:2, Acts 5:29, Acts 18:9-11); references are added for the reader. At 18:34 a quote about the pulpit being responsible for moral decline is attributed to Charles Wesley as spoken; this attribution has not been checked.

chunks.section_question: What was it like to be at the conference in person?
chunks.short_answer: He says that getting emails about people being attacked feels distant, but there he felt very close to the attacks and to well-known people willing to speak to a group of fewer than a hundred. He says their hearts were begging pastors to wake up, stand and unite, and that everyone who believes in Christ and believes in freedom was welcomed.

As part of the church. Part of America you sign up for these emails and you get this information about people that are being attacked and you feel very distant but when I was there. They were right there they were experiencing it I felt very close to the attacks. I felt very close to the people who were willing to come to a group of less than a hundred people. Very famous people willing to come to a small group and say pastors it’s time it’s time we wake up and stand. And these guys their hearts were just begging begging anyone we need to unite. But that doesn’t mean we stop preaching the gospel and living right and taken a seat on the sideline and watching the destruction of the world when way can have an effect. And God spoke to me in the year in this thing that America needs to hear a message of hope. Not a message of despair and destruction and it’s the end they need a message of hope illustration number one David was an adolescent young man.

chunks.short_answer: He says Goliath was the propaganda voice for the Philistines and Israel’s army hid, until a teenager, David, asked who he thought he was to speak against God. He says David cut off the head, the army rose up and drove the Philistines out, and “one person brought unity because one person brought hope.”

scriptures.text_nkjv: Then David said to the Philistine, “You come to me with a sword, with a spear, and with a javelin. But I come to you in the name of the LORD of hosts, the God of the armies of Israel, whom you have defied. This day the LORD will deliver you into my hand, and I will strike you and take your head from you. And this day I will give the carcasses of the camp of the Philistines to the birds of the air and the wild beasts of the earth, that all the earth may know that there is a God in Israel. Then all this assembly shall know that the LORD does not save with sword and spear; for the battle is the LORD’s, and He will give you into our hands.” So it was, when the Philistine arose and came and drew near to meet David, that David hurried and ran toward the army to meet the Philistine. Then David put his hand in his bag and took out a stone; and he slung it and struck the Philistine in his forehead, so that the stone sank into his forehead, and he fell on his face to the earth. So David prevailed over the Philistine with a sling and a stone, and struck the Philistine and killed him. But there was no sword in the hand of David. Therefore David ran and stood over the Philistine, took his sword and drew it out of its sheath and killed him, and cut off his head with it. And when the Philistines saw that their champion was dead, they fled.

chunks.section_question: Why did God tell Paul not to be afraid in Corinth?
chunks.short_answer: He says the Jews in Corinth opposed and abused Paul, but Jesus told him not to be afraid and to preach, because he had many people in that city, so Paul preached there a year and a half. He says God is telling this church there are many in Elsinore and in California on his side who need a message of hope.

See one person brought unity because one person brought hope. And an adolescent. Saul second illustration. He went to Corinth. He preached Christ crucified he was the messiah the anointed one to come the Jews didn’t like it. scriptures.text_nkjv: Now the Lord spoke to Paul in the night by a vision, “Do not be afraid, but speak, and do not keep silent; for I am with you, and no one will attack you to hurt you; for I have many people in this city.” And he continued there a year and six months, teaching the word of God among them.

faqs.question: Who has authority over the nations?
faqs.answer: He reports the speakers’ message that America does not belong to Satan, because Jesus Christ said all authority has been given to him, over all the nations.

scriptures.text_nkjv: And Jesus came and spoke to them, saying, “All authority has been given to Me in heaven and on earth.

faqs.question: Were believers from other churches welcomed at the conference?
faqs.answer: He says the atmosphere was “we want everyone” who believes in Christ and believes in freedom, including people from other traditions, and a very charismatic woman was never corrected.

faqs.question: What is righteousness?
faqs.answer: He says maybe others interpret righteousness differently, but “we know where righteousness is”: right living, living the right way.

faqs.question: Who is responsible when morals decline?
faqs.answer: He reports a quote that if there is a moral decline in America the pulpit is responsible, which he calls a call to pastors to wake up and stand.

faqs.question: Why did he check what the speakers said?
faqs.answer: He says being asked to share made him realize he had to share truth, not just his opinion, so he had to prove things and look the speakers up instead of just taking what they said.

faqs.question: Did the conference ask for money?
faqs.answer: He says the handouts and food were free and they never asked for money, which he thought very commendable.

faqs.question: What kind of unity does God want among churches?
faqs.answer: He says God told him “we need to be united in the spirit,” with the same spirit burning in every church, not just the letter or words.

faqs.question: Is the church planning to join with others?
faqs.answer: The pastor says he is looking for a grassroots organization throughout America to unite with, because it saves time not to start your own from scratch.

faqs.question: If Jesus is coming soon, should we stop trying to change things?
faqs.answer: The pastor says these things are supposed to happen, but that does not mean we stop preaching the gospel and living right and take a seat on the sideline watching the destruction when we can have an effect.

faqs.question: Why does he point out that David cut off Goliath’s head?
faqs.answer: He says when you cut the head off you destroy the whole organization; if we stop the leaders we stop the movement, so we must go right to the heads of opposing groups.

faqs.question: What does he say California needs?
faqs.answer: He says there are many people in California, as bad as it is, who are on God’s side but need a message of hope, instruction and someone to tell them “this is the way.”
